message:
Fixed: "Crème brûlée recipes" now becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes (3 of 3).

The slug logic lives in `vendor/slugify/index.js`, which strips every non-ASCII letter. That folder is marked "do not edit by hand", so I left it alone. Instead, `src/blog/slug.js` now decomposes accented characters and removes the accent marks before calling `slugify`. The change is one line.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also uses slugs. I didn't check whether it calls the same vendored function, so shop URLs may still drop accented letters.
